Chrome Extension Setup Guide

Sync live Canvas courses & syllabus objectives in 10 seconds

1
Open Extensions in your Browser

In Chrome, Edge, or Brave, navigate to chrome://extensions.

2
Enable "Developer mode"

Toggle ON the Developer mode toggle in the top-right corner.

3
Click "Load unpacked"

Click the Load unpacked button and select the Extension folder inside this package.

4
Go to Canvas & Click Sync

Navigate to canvas.vt.edu and click the extension icon to scrub and launch your study plan with 1 click!
